name: Sangjeong Gogeum Yemun metal-type edition
description: A Goryeo metal-type printing of Sangjeong Gogeum Yemun is recorded in a postface; the museum account reports 28 copies.

date.label: estimated 1234–1241
date.basis: Yoo and Yun estimate 1234–1241 from historical literature. The museum dates the postface around 1234; neither provides an inspected dated edition in this lane.

events.statement: A postface records printing 28 copies using movable metal type; a secondary synthesis estimates the printing at 1234–1241.
events.caveats: The printed copies have not been found according to Yoo and Yun. The postface itself was not inspected in the original language; date is an estimate. No direction of technological transmission to the Jikji edition is established.

evidence.supports: Museum describes a postface recording 28 copies printed with movable metal type in Goryeo.
A secondary synthesis estimates printing between 1234 and 1241 and notes no copies found.

earliest_record.rationale: The estimated period of a historically reported edition, not a surviving copy or a demonstrated first invention.

caveats: The record is a reported edition, not the origin of metal type or evidence that its particular types or methods passed to the Jikji printers.

unresolved.note: What contemporary testimony and independently informative scholarship establish any continuity between this reported print and Jikji’s metal-type production?
Can the original postface and early textual witnesses be inspected, translated and dated more securely?
